Change ONLY its canopy hue from orange to EMERALD/TEAL green with mint highlights and deeper teal shade. EVERY canopy lobe stays within this ONE teal-green color family. The honey-gold tan trunks and cream-white outline remain unchanged. NO rainbow foliage, NO multicolored crown, NO orange or pink patches mixed into purple, NO yellow or purple patches mixed into teal.
